answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money — sparingly and against verified performance — so Sybil inflation is filtered before it compounds. Think of a river for stability, a signal for surprise, a cipher for peace — three qualities no Sybil can counterfeit in quantity.
